1.title: OSGi Bundle Repositories (OBR)
1.content: Pre-built OSGi Bundle Repository index files for Eclipse releases, suitable for use with BndTools and Eclipse IDE setups. Browse OBR files . Available index files for Eclipse versions: 3.6.2, 3.7.2, 3.8.2, 4.3.2, 4.4.0, 4.4.1, 4.6.0, 4.6.1 (Platform and Simultaneous releases).
